theorems.name: Submission.lpf_lipschitz_localization
theorems.statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (u : Eucl n → Eucl Q), IsOpen Ω → LocallyLipschitzOn Ω u → ∃ (B : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)) (v : ℕ → Eucl n → Eucl Q), (∀ m, IsOpen (B m)) ∧ (∀ m, B m ⊆ Ω) ∧ Ω ⊆ ⋃ m, B m ∧ (∀ m, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K (v m)) ∧ ∀ m, EqOn u (v m) (B m)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
